claims.claim: Prior-matched Bernoulli gates and learned amplitudes can yield accurate reconstructions that disappear under thresholding; determine whether replication occurs in learned VG-SAE.
queries: dropout matrix factorization duplication columns regularization Cavazza 2018
claims.delta: Only a causal empirical characterization of learned conditional-amplitude VG-SAE, with prior-floor/bias and stochastic-risk controls, could carry. Replica variance algebra is already published.

excluded_claim.claim: The 1/r replication variance dilution and width-dependent retain-probability correction are new mathematical results.
excluded_claim.published_paper: Cavazza et al., Dropout as a Low-Rank Regularizer for Matrix Factorization, AISTATS 2018, §4 Eq13/Proposition1 and §5 Eq15

claims.claim: Calibrate support gate probabilities against exact support posteriors, distinguishing fixed known amplitudes from learned input-dependent amplitudes and identifiable groups.
claims.delta: A checkable delta is the controlled separation of exact-generative support posterior, mean-field approximation, linear amortization, and learned-amplitude target mismatch in this VG architecture; no identical study was located.
claims.limits: Not proof of absence. Probabilistic TopK full calibration appendix unavailable; real-activation semantic uncertainty remains ungrounded.

claims.claim: Dictionary-aware sparse decisions or amplitude readout may improve VG hard reconstruction at fixed support budget.
queries: "Decoupling Shrinkage and Selection in Bayesian Linear Models" arxiv
"The Median Probability Model and Correlated Variables" Barbieri Berger George
claims.delta: Selection/amplitude attribution in learned VG may be informative, but posterior projection, threshold limits, NNLS, and pursuit are established tools; matched-L0 and compute-matched gains must be VG-specific.

claims.claim: Frozen-model gate refinement separates amortization error from VG objective and hard-code error.
queries: "Compute Optimal Inference and Provable Amortisation Gap" sparse
"The Price of Amortized inference in Sparse Autoencoders"
"paired mean field" Titsias Lazaro Gredilla spike slab 2012
claims.delta: Gate-only coordinate descent under an unchanged known VG free energy can test the direction of hard support quality independently of amplitude refitting. Generic inference-time improvement is already established.

rankings.reason: Mechanism-plus-occurrence package; exact algebra not new; includes B01 and B08 as controls.
Exact posterior reference and target separation supply highest independent scientific upside.
Directional diagnostic for unchanged VG objective; generic amortization gap already published.
High upside if a specific competition failure is repaired; oracle pairs and general structured VI are not a finished SAE method.
Sparse posterior projection is known; must beat pursuit/refit and expose a VG-specific phenomenon.
Useful variance/precision feedback diagnostic; real-activation noise target is unavailable.
Rare-feature empirical Bayes can reveal feedback failure; prior adaptation itself standard.
Beta-Bernoulli adaptive counts face BatchTopK, SoftSAE and sparse attention competition.
Very useful supporting intervention; unlikely independent paper contribution without consequential finding.
Cheap necessary attribution control, not a new NNLS or amplitude method.
Necessary width/prior control; standalone rule is near dropout scaling and multiplicity priors.

overall.scope: Bounded diagnostic study of gate-probability semantics and mean/stochastic/hard readouts in learned VG-SAE; no new replication theorem, no established width cure, no broad probabilistic-SAE failure claim.

pilot_caveats.findings: Construction numerically verified; fixed-pi width gap grows, but learned variance increases rather than follows 1/r. Fixed-count prior and tested simple readouts do not establish a cure.
root_followup_not_independently_recomput: Near-prior group removal includes a substantial constant/bias contribution, reduced under train-mean replacement.
pilot_caveats.interpretation: Mean reconstruction is not the expected stochastic loss optimized by the model. Mean-vs-hard gap alone is not proof of objective/deployment mismatch. Learned replica mechanism remains unproven.
independently_recomputed: All ten trained configurations have hard EV greater than stochastic reconstruction EV, calculated from mean EV minus 2*variance_energy/test_centered_energy.
pilot_caveats.posterior_pilot: Orthogonal posterior is representable by the linear sigmoid, so its observed amortized gap includes incomplete optimization. In coherent095, refinement lowers Brier but increases marginal NLL (.13069 to .16030); cannot claim all calibration improves. Fixed known generative model only.
